Edit.Title: Preset Editor
Edit.Subtitle: Create your own preset with ReShade, live on map screenshots. When you're happy with it, save it to your library.
Edit.Name: Preset name *
Edit.InvalidName: The name can't contain \ / : * ? < > | or quotes.
Edit.DraftExists: A draft with this name exists: opening the editor continues it.
Edit.HowTo: In the editor press Home to open ReShade: tick the effects you want and move their sliders. Every change is saved automatically. Press Print Screen to take the screenshot that will be the preset's preview, then close the window (ESC) when you're done.
Edit.Editing: Editor open: close its window to continue here.
Edit.ConfirmDiscard: Delete the draft "{0}" and start over?
Edit.ScreenshotHint: The last screenshot taken in the editor is used automatically; you can choose another one.
Edit.Saved:
Preset "{0}" saved to your library!

You'll find it in Install Preset, ready to use in the game.

Man.Subtitle: Add your own ReShade presets to the library, or remove the ones you don't use.
Man.SourceHint: Link to where the preset comes from: video, website, Discord…

Replace it?
Man.ConfirmDelete:
Delete the preset "{0}"?

It won't be downloaded again by the automatic update.
Man.ConflictOfficial:
"{0}" has the same name as an official preset.

Yes: save yours as a separate copy (recommended).
No: replace the official one on this PC (it stops receiving updates).
Cancel: don't save.
Man.ConfirmDeleteOverride:

Man.RestoreOffline:
The deleted presets will come back, but GitHub can't be reached right now.

They'll be downloaded at the next start or with "Update presets".

App.ReportBugInfo:
Discord will open: describe the problem in the bug-report channel and attach today's log file.

The logs folder opens too, so you can drag the file into your message.
Inst.CloseGame:
Close Dead by Daylight before installing.

While the game is open ReShade's files are in use, and ReShade would undo the changes when the game closes.
